name: VolunteerManager
description: A simple Ruby on Rails app to manage volunteers and volunteer groups for associations.

paragraphs: AVM is a digital tool for keeping track of an association's technical volunteers and the various groups they belong to. Volunteers can have many goups and groups can have many volunteers, which are linked by a Statement of Expertise unique to each group per volunteer. The app allows you to create, read/view, update, and delete volunteers, groups, and their statements, email any group with one click, and even store your volunteers' CVs. It offers numerous ways to filter each of these categories in an effort to make it as easy as possible for the system user to obtain the data the need fast.…
